meta.name: ab-testing
meta.description: When the user wants to plan, design, or implement an A/B test or experiment, or build a growth experimentation program. Also use when the user mentions "A/B test," "split test," "experiment," "test this change," "variant copy," "multivariate test," "hypothesis," "should I test this," "which version is better," "test two versions," "statistical significance," "how long should I run this test," "growth experiments," "experiment velocity," "experiment backlog," "ICE score," "experimentation program," or "experiment playbook." Use this whenever someone is comparing two approaches and wants to measure which performs better, or when they want to build a systematic experimentation practice. For tracking implementation, see analytics. For page-level conversion optimization, see cro.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计并运行科学的A/B实验，用数据决策版本优劣
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 你常纠结两个版本哪个更好，想用数据说话。
copy.tagline_en: Design and run A/B tests to choose better versions with data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often decide between versions and want data-driven answers.

howto.what: 装上后，当用户讨论A/B测试或实验时，Claude会引导完成测试设计：询问当前转化率、流量等背景，要求写清楚假设，再给出样本量、指标、变体设计和结果分析建议；还可读取产品营销上下文文件。
howto.when: 当用户提到“A/B test”、“split test”、“experiment”等关键词，或想比较两种方案并衡量哪种更好、想建立系统化实验流程时触发；规划、设计或实施A/B测试时也会触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个A/B测试，我想提高注册率。
say.note: Claude会询问当前转化率、流量，并引导你写假设。

say.text: 两个版本的定价页面，哪个更好？该怎么测？
say.note: Claude会给出测试设计、样本量和指标建议。

say.text: 我想搭建一个持续的增长实验计划，该从哪开始？
say.note: Claude会介绍实验循环、ICE评分和节奏。

howto.what_en: Claude guides A/B test design: asks for baseline conversion, traffic, and hypothesis, then advises on sample size, metrics, variants, and analysis. Can read product marketing context files first.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users mention keywords like "A/B test," "split test," or "experiment," compare two approaches, or want to build a systematic experimentation program. Also when planning, designing, or implementing a test.

say_en.text: Help me design an A/B test to increase signups.
say_en.note: Claude asks for conversion rate, traffic, and hypothesis.

say_en.text: Which of two pricing page versions is better? How should I test?
say_en.note: Claude suggests test design, sample size, and metrics.

say_en.text: I want to build an ongoing growth experimentation program. Where do I start?
say_en.note: Claude explains the experiment loop, ICE scoring, and cadence.
